steps.title: Define Application Requirements
steps.description: Outline the core features for the Modern Calculator app, including basic arithmetic operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division), clear functionality, and a responsive UI.

steps.title: Set Up Android Project Structure
steps.description: Create the foundational directory structure for the 'Modern Calculator' app, including the 'app' module and 'src/main' folders.

steps.title: Configure AndroidManifest.xml
steps.description: Set up the application's manifest file at app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml. Define the package name 'com.moderncalculator.app', app label 'Modern Calculator', activity 'MainActivity', and specify icon resources.

steps.title: Configure app/build.gradle
steps.description: Set the Android Gradle Plugin (AGP) version to 8.3.2, Gradle to 8.5, compileSdkVersion to 34, targetSdkVersion to 34, and minSdkVersion to 21. Define the namespace and applicationId as 'com.moderncalculator.app'. Ensure no external dependencies are added.

steps.title: Create activity_main.xml Layout
steps.description: Design the main layout for the calculator at app/src/main/res/layout/activity_main.xml. This XML will define the display area and the grid of calculator buttons using LinearLayout and GridLayout.

steps.title: Implement Calculator Display TextView
steps.description: Add a TextView to activity_main.xml that will serve as the calculator's display, showing input and results. Configure its styling for a modern look.

steps.title: Implement Calculator Button GridLayout
steps.description: Structure the calculator buttons (digits, operators, clear, equals, decimal) using a GridLayout within activity_main.xml for a clean, organized layout.

steps.title: Create MainActivity.java Class
steps.description: Develop the main activity class at app/src/main/java/com/moderncalculator/app/MainActivity.java. This class will handle all UI interactions and calculator logic.

steps.title: Initialize UI Elements in MainActivity
steps.description: In MainActivity.java, initialize references to the TextView display and all calculator Buttons by their IDs defined in activity_main.xml.

steps.title: Implement OnClickListener for Buttons
steps.description: Attach OnClickListener instances to each calculator button in MainActivity.java to respond to user input. Use anonymous inner classes for Java 8 compatibility.

steps.title: Implement Digit and Decimal Input Logic
steps.description: Add logic within MainActivity.java to handle digit and decimal button presses, building the current number input and updating the display TextView.

steps.title: Implement Operator Input Logic
steps.description: Develop logic in MainActivity.java for handling operator (+, -, *, /) button presses, storing the first operand and the selected operator.

steps.title: Implement Clear (C) Functionality
steps.description: Add code to MainActivity.java to reset the calculator's state (display, operands, operator) when the 'C' button is pressed.

steps.title: Implement Equals (=) Calculation Logic
steps.description: Write the core calculation logic in MainActivity.java that evaluates the expression when the '=' button is pressed, using the stored operand, operator, and current input.

steps.title: Add Division by Zero Error Handling
steps.description: Include checks in the calculation logic within MainActivity.java to prevent division by zero errors and display an appropriate message to the user.

steps.title: Ensure Java 8 Compatibility
steps.description: Review all Java code in MainActivity.java to ensure strict compatibility with Java 8, avoiding features like lambdas or method references.

steps.title: Refine UI and UX
steps.description: Perform a final review of the app's user interface and user experience, making any necessary adjustments to button sizes, spacing, and color scheme for a polished 'Modern Calculator' look and feel.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Compile the 'Modern Calculator' application using Gradle to generate the debug APK, confirming that all components are correctly integrated and build successfully.
